title: The Word as Five-Minted Coin: How Truth Becomes Communicable
description: A word, born in the interior, is shaped by five organs of the mouth (throat, tongue, teeth, lips, mouth itself) into an audible form that crosses to another's ear. Likened to a coin minted by five artisans (engraving, cutting, stamping the seal, forging the blank body) before passing into commerce — the descent of truth into a communicable likeness as a five-fold work of the natural-rational interface.
